stories.text: v1.6.1 继承 v1.6.0 行为轴
boundary 负例在 case 或 truth
matrix 37 条与 projection 一致
每条 skill 有 trace 或 blocked
100% live pass 或全量 blocked 报告
CI tier degraded + smoke 计数
release hook tier 契约在 truth

scenarios.title: exit 0 或 BLOCKED:Phase-A
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && beacon eval --help >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-001.txt 2>&1 && rg -q 'catalog' .beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-001.txt && rg -q 'scorecard' .beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-001.txt && python3 -m pytest tests/test_v161_agent_eval.py::test_agent_eval_help_lists_subcommands -q --junitxml "${BEACON_JUNIT_PATH:-.beacon/junit.xml}"

scenarios.title: catalog JSON 存在
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && beacon eval catalog --project-root . --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-002.json 2>&1 && test -f docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-capability-catalog-v161.json

scenarios.title: 四类 harness 在 catalog
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-capability-catalog-v161.json')); h=set(x.get('harness') for x in c.get('entries',[])); assert {'pln','gen','eval','gov'}.issubset(h)"

scenarios.title: traces 或明确 blocked
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --project-root . --split regression-core --runner replay --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-004.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-004.json')); assert d.get('traces_path') or d.get('status')=='blocked'" && python3 -m pytest tests/test_v161_agent_eval.py::test_agent_eval_catalog_materialize -q --junitxml "${BEACON_JUNIT_PATH:-.beacon/junit.xml}"

scenarios.title: 六维 + composite
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --project-root . --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-005.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-005.json')); dims=d.get('dimensions',{}); assert len(dims)>=6 and 'composite_score' in d"

scenarios.title: authority 字段正确
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --project-root . --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-006.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-006.json')); a=d.get('authority',d); assert d.get('runtime_evidence_only') is True and d.get('formal_verdict_authority') is False"

scenarios.title: simulated 降级标记
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --project-root . --version v1.6.1 --runner simulated --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-007.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-007.json')); assert d.get('degraded') is True and 'simulated_composite_score' in d"

scenarios.title: 无 admission 时 blocked
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --project-root . --runner live --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-008.json 2>&1; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-008.json')); assert d.get('status')=='blocked' and d.get('reason_code')=='agent_eval_live_runner_not_admitted'"

scenarios.title: admission 存在时可启动
scenarios.command: test -f docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-runner-admission.json && mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --project-root . --runner live --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-009.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-009.json')); assert d.get('status') in ('pass','running','completed')"

scenarios.title: 四类 artifact 目录
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval benchmark --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-010.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json,glob; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-010.json')); root=d.get('root',''); assert all(glob.glob(root+'/**/'+x, recursive=True) or x in str(d) for x in ['eval_metadata','grading','benchmark','analysis'])"

scenarios.title: grading 含多配置
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json,glob; import pathlib; b=pathlib.Path('.beacon/state/agent-eval/benchmarks'); bs=sorted(b.glob('*'))[-1] if b.exists() else None; g=list(bs.glob('grading/*.json')) if bs else []; assert len(g)>=2"

scenarios.title: grading 含 critique
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json,pathlib; b=pathlib.Path('.beacon/state/agent-eval/benchmarks'); bs=sorted(b.glob('*'))[-1] if b.exists() else None; found=any('critique' in str(v) for p in (bs.glob('grading/*.json') if bs else []) for v in json.load(open(p)).values()); assert found"

scenarios.title: analysis 声明不替代 QA
scenarios.command: test -f .beacon/state/agent-eval/benchmarks/*/analysis/analysis.md||rg -q 'formal.*QA' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: v1.6.1 继承 v1.6.0 行为轴
scenarios.command: rg -q 'TC-006' beacon/utils/skill_eval_kit.py && rg -q 'TC-017' beacon/utils/skill_eval_kit.py && rg -q 'v1.6.1' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md
scenarios.assertion: v1.6.1 继承 v1.6.0 行为轴

scenarios.title: boundary 负例在 case 或 truth
scenarios.command: rg -q 'hard-gate' .beacon/state/skill-eval/cases.json 2>/dev/null||rg -q 'boundary' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md
scenarios.assertion: boundary 负例在 case 或 truth

scenarios.title: eval-agent skill + gate
scenarios.command: test -f skills/beacon/beacon-eval-agent/SKILL.md && rg -q 'HARD GATE' skills/beacon/beacon-eval-agent/SKILL.md && rg -q 'release verdict' skills/beacon/beacon-eval-agent/SKILL.md

scenarios.title: FSM 单测
scenarios.command: rg -q 'AgentEvalState' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && python3 -m pytest tests/test_agent_eval_state_contract.py -q --junitxml "${BEACON_JUNIT_PATH:-.beacon/junit.xml}"

scenarios.title: recovery 路径单测
scenarios.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_agent_eval_state_contract.py -q -k recovery --junitxml "${BEACON_JUNIT_PATH:-.beacon/junit.xml}"

scenarios.title: catalog 含 plan start
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-capability-catalog-v161.json')); ids=[x.get('id','') for x in c.get('entries',[])]; assert any('plan start' in i or 'plan.start' in i for i in ids)"

scenarios.title: acceptance kit 桥接声明
scenarios.command: rg -q 'trace-scorecard' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'acceptance-kit' beacon/utils/acceptance_kit.py

scenarios.title: anti-fake-delivery
scenarios.command: rg -q 'anti-fake-delivery' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'fake_delivery' beacon/utils/skill_eval_kit.py

scenarios.title: 中文 truth
scenarios.command: rg -q 'Agent Eval' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q '验收标准' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: SUMMARY 索引
scenarios.command: rg -q 'beacon-agent-eval-v161' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/SUMMARY.md

scenarios.title: skill eval kit 桥接
scenarios.command: rg -q 'skill.eval' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'skill_eval' beacon/utils/skill_eval_kit.py

scenarios.title: doctor surface 在 catalog
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-capability-catalog-v161.json')); ids=' '.join(x.get('id','') for x in c.get('entries',[])); assert 'verify-agent-surface' in ids"

scenarios.title: 权重在 truth
scenarios.command: rg -q 'route_stability' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q '15%' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: regression pass 时 composite≥70
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --split regression-core --runner replay --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-027-run.json 2>&1 && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-027-sc.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-027-sc.json')); assert d.get('composite_score',0)>=70 or d.get('status')=='blocked'"

scenarios.title: scope_mode + deferral 表
scenarios.command: rg -q 'full_parity' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'Deferral Ledger' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: exit 0
scenarios.command: rg -q '## user_decision' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/research/beacon-agent-eval-v161.md && rg -q '^promoted$' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/research/beacon-agent-eval-v161.md && rg -q 'promotion_ref' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/research/beacon-agent-eval-v161.md

scenarios.title: matrix 37 条与 projection 一致
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json; from beacon.utils.agent_surface import v160_skill_package_projection; m=json.load(open('docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-live-skill-matrix-v161.json')); ids={x['skill_id'] for x in m.get('entries',[])}; exp={p.id for p in v160_skill_package_projection()}|{'beacon-eval-agent'}; assert ids==exp"
scenarios.assertion: matrix 37 条与 projection 一致

scenarios.title: 每条 skill 有 trace 或 blocked
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --project-root . --split regression-core --runner live --live-tier ci_default --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-031.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-031.json')); per=d.get('per_skill',[]); assert len(per)>=37; assert all('live_execution_mode' in x for x in per)"
scenarios.assertion: 每条 skill 有 trace 或 blocked

scenarios.title: 100% live pass 或全量 blocked 报告
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --project-root . --version v1.6.1 --runner live --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032.json')); t=d.get('live_skill_total',0); assert t>=37; p=d.get('live_skill_pass',0); assert p==t or d.get('live_coverage_blocked') is True"
scenarios.assertion: 100% live pass 或全量 blocked 报告

scenarios.title: R2 change intent 写入
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import re; t=open('docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md').read(); pb=re.search(r'## Phased Backlog.*?(?=\\n## )', t, re.S); section=pb.group(0) if pb else ''; assert '全 skill live' in t and 'change_reason' in t and '|PB-AE-001|' not in section"

scenarios.title: local tier host 100% 或 blocked
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && test -f docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-runner-admission.json && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --project-root . --runner live --live-tier local_admitted --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032a-run.json 2>&1 && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --project-root . --runner live --live-tier local_admitted --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032a-sc.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032a-sc.json')); t=d.get('live_skill_total',0); p=d.get('live_skill_pass',0); assert t>=37 and (p==t or d.get('live_coverage_blocked') is True)"

scenarios.title: CI tier degraded + smoke 计数
scenarios.command: mkdir -p .beacon/qa-tmp && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval run --project-root . --runner live --live-tier ci_default --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032b-run.json 2>&1 && BEACON_ALLOW_CONTEXT_VERSION_DRIFT=1 beacon eval scorecard --project-root . --runner live --live-tier ci_default --version v1.6.1 --json >.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032b-sc.json 2>&1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.beacon/qa-tmp/TC-AE-032b-sc.json')); assert d.get('degraded') is True; assert d.get('live_smoke_pass',0) in (0,1)"
scenarios.assertion: CI tier degraded + smoke 计数

scenarios.title: tier 契约在 truth
scenarios.command: rg -q 'live_execution_tier' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'ci_default' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'live-tier' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: 37 fixture 文件存在
scenarios.command: python3 -c "import json,glob; m=json.load(open('docs/beacon/v1.6.1/.machine/execution/agent-eval-live-skill-matrix-v161.json')); refs=[e['prompt_fixture_ref'] for e in m['entries']]; assert len(refs)>=37; assert all(__import__('pathlib').Path(r).exists() for r in refs)"

scenarios.title: grader ROUTE/boundary 单测
scenarios.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_v161_agent_eval_grader.py -q --junitxml "${BEACON_JUNIT_PATH:-.beacon/junit.xml}"

scenarios.title: release hook tier 契约在 truth
scenarios.command: rg -q 'release_hook' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'post-release' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md
scenarios.assertion: release hook tier 契约在 truth

scenarios.title: behavior 仅 host
scenarios.command: rg -q 'behavior_evidence_source: host_behavior_only' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'surface_only' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: host trace 契约声明
scenarios.command: rg -q 'transcript_ref' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'host_behavior' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md

scenarios.title: R3 change + deferral
scenarios.command: rg -q 'R3 tiered live closure' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'DL-LIVE-002' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md && rg -q 'Option A' docs/beacon/v1.6.1/features/beacon-agent-eval-v161/truth.md
